title: To amend the Jeanne Clery Campus Safety Act to combat campus sexual assault, and for other purposes.

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Education and Workforce, and in addition to the Committee on the Judiciary, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
